summit.label: The starred tables — Faro's first star and the two-star kitchens of the coast

stories.label: Tables with a story — a lunch on an island with no road, and a chef's small room inside the walls

street.label: La Rue — the two markets and the bifana

cut.v05-faz-gostos: Cut on the 24 Oct re-check: no 2026 trace of it trading, and CHECKin has occupied its rooms on Rua do Castelo since July 2022 (Postal do Algarve); the old record's 'Michelin Plate' is a distinction MICHELIN no longer awards. Its lane keeps two.
cut.v18-bon-bon: Cut for the cap: the third starred kitchen of the coast and the furthest west (Carvoeiro, about 50 minutes); the grand lane keeps Faro's own star and the two two-star kitchens. Named on the lane story.
cut.v06-vila-adentro: Cut for the cap: a tiled room on the cathedral square, but the walled-town lane keeps three tables with a stronger story (CHECKin, Faz Gostos, and the island lunch); Vila Adentro's square is the Cidade Velha quarter card.
cut.v07-tert-lia-algarvia: Moved, not lost: its cataplana class is weighed in the craft section (as a card, if the re-check confirms it); as a table it duplicated the tascas lane.
cut.v10-a-do-pinto: Cut: 'a word-of-mouth address' with no fact the guide could stand on; the tascas lane keeps three with a dated record.
cut.v13-bago-wine-bar: Moved, not lost: a wine bar is not a table. It keeps a card at the glass (its own address and map), and leaves the venue list.
cut.v14-hotel-faro-rooftop: Moved, not lost: a rooftop bar is not a table. It keeps a card at the glass (its own address and map), and leaves the venue list.
cut.v15-morgado-do-quint-o: Moved, not lost: a wine estate is not a table. It keeps a card in the larder's cellars (its own address and map), and leaves the venue list.

v-snack-bar-da-xica.name: Snack Bar da Xica
v-snack-bar-da-xica.address: Mercado Municipal de Faro, Largo Dr. Francisco Sá Carneiro, 8000-151 Faro
v-snack-bar-da-xica.verdict: Faro's reference bifana: thin pork loin marinated in white wine, garlic and paprika, griddled to order and slid into a papo-seco roll, at a counter inside the city market.
v-snack-bar-da-xica.signature: A bifana and a small beer at the counter.
